name: hipfire-kernel-tuning
description: Optimize hipfire HIP/compute kernels already on the supported RDNA/CDNA matrix: pick one lever (multi-row, K-tile, prefetch, wave-size port, WMMA/MFMA sibling, fused projection, ISA flags, perf-variant allowlist), validate with the narrow VALIDATION.md route, and keep unmeasured arches on portable fallbacks. Case studies are dated evidence (wins, reverts, nulls)—not live floors. Use when a profiler-hot kernel needs a real win without cross-arch regressions or capability-predicate perf selection.
triggers: kernel runs slow at low batch
should I add a multi-row variant

requires.rocm: checkout- and target-arch-supported ROCm/HIP toolchain (no universal version floor; e.g. gfx1151-class and gfx12 paths need the toolchain the tree documents for that arch)
requires.hardware: target GPU arch for any perf claim; unmeasured arches stay on portable/opt-in paths
